name: Multi-Block Binary Meshing with AO
definition: Generates mesh vertices for a face direction, iterating over all block types and axes, handling ambient occlusion (AO) by packing it into the p_index.
summary: Multi-Block Binary Meshing with AO generates mesh vertices for voxel chunks while preserving per-vertex ambient occlusion values, unlike variants that treat blocks as opaque with zero occlusion.
